headline: INFILL CONFIRMS GRADE CONTINUITY — FREEGOLD DRILLS 62m AT 2.08 g/t Au IN 17.2M OZ ALASKA RESOURCE, PFS CLOCK TICKING (TSX:FVL)
source_name: Investing News Network / Freegold Ventures Ltd. (TSX:FVL)
snippet: Freegold Ventures Ltd. (TSX:FVL) reported July 2 that infill drill hole GS2607 at its Golden Summit Project in Alaska returned 2.08 g/t Au over 62.1 metres within a broader 102.3-metre interval at 1.67 g/t Au, including high-grade sections of 16.72 g/t Au over 1.4 metres and 10.16 g/t Au over 2.6 metres — confirming grade continuity across the higher-value Dolphin–Cleary–WOW corridors targeted for a starter-pit scenario. With six rigs active in a 50,000-metre 2026 drill program designed to complete infill, geotechnical, and condemnation work for a Pre-Feasibility Study targeted in 2027, the results bolster the case that Golden Summit's 17.2 million-ounce Indicated Resource at 1.24 g/t Au can support economically compelling open-pit mining — at a gold price of US$5,000/oz the after-tax NPV already exceeds US$1.5 billion.

headline: PERU GREENLIGHTS CONSTANCIA AT 34 MTPA — HUDBAY'S FIFTH CAPACITY PERMIT LIFTS COPPER THROUGHPUT 10% WITH ZERO NEW CAPEX (TSX:HBM)
snippet: Hudbay Minerals Inc. (TSX:HBM) announced July 2 that Peru's SENACE environmental authority has approved the fifth permit amendment at its Constancia copper mine in the Cusco Region, lifting permitted mill throughput from 31 to 34 million tonnes per annum with flexibility to process up to 10% above that ceiling on any given day. The incremental throughput unlocks additional copper and molybdenum production at one of the hemisphere's largest copper skarns without requiring a new mine build — the approval follows a March 2026 amendment that had already lifted capacity from 29.9 to 31 mtpa, reflecting a systematic brownfield expansion strategy that has taken Constancia from its original design capacity to 34+ mtpa through five successive regulatory approvals, demonstrating Peru's continued support for responsible copper production as global supply tightens.

headline: 196% MORE INDICATED — MITHRIL'S 615K OZ AuEq COPALQUIN TARGET 1 COSTS UNDER $20/OZ TO DISCOVER WITH 75% HIGH-CONFIDENCE (ASX:MTH)
source_name: Small Caps / Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd. (ASX:MTH / TSXV:MSG)
snippet: Mithril Silver and Gold Ltd. (ASX:MTH / TSXV:MSG) released June 30 an upgraded Mineral Resource Estimate for Target 1 at its Copalquin Project in Durango, Mexico — 615,000 oz AuEq in total, with the Indicated component at 3.391 million tonnes grading 3.15 g/t Au and 77.8 g/t Ag (343,000 oz Au, 8.48 Moz Ag) representing a 196% increase versus the prior estimate and pushing 75% of combined resources into the higher-confidence classification. After 60,000 metres of drilling across 204 holes, the all-in discovery cost is under US$20 per oz AuEq using US$3,300/oz gold — an exceptional efficiency metric for a polymetallic high-grade system in the Sierra Madre corridor that hosts multiple additional targets at earlier exploration stages.

headline: HOOK MIRRORS LEVIATHAN — HERCULES' 7-LINE IP DEFINES 1.8km PORPHYRY COPPER ANOMALY WITH DRILLING UNDERWAY IN IDAHO (TSXV:BIG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Hercules Metals Corp. (TSXV:BIG)
snippet: Hercules Metals Corp. (TSXV:BIG) reported completion of 28 line-kilometres of induced polarization surveying across seven lines at the Hook target on its Hercules Property in western Idaho, defining a 1.8-kilometre continuous near-surface chargeability anomaly that exhibits the same geometry, intensity, and strike orientation as the signature at the Leviathan porphyry copper discovery — where drilling has already returned 788 metres at 0.54% copper equivalent. Reconnaissance drilling at Hook is now underway testing the strongest chargeability identified on the property to date, as the company works to establish Hercules as a multi-deposit porphyry copper district in the western United States during a period when new copper supply is the mining sector's single most sought-after discovery.

headline: 5,212 LINE-KM DONE — TRACTION URANIUM COMPLETES HIGH-RES SURVEY ON 17km OF SE ATHABASCA BASIN MARGIN (CSE:TRAC)
snippet: Traction Uranium Corp. announced July 2 that its high-resolution airborne radiometric and aeromagnetic survey is complete at the Aurora Uranium Project in the southeastern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan — 5,212 line-kilometres of low-level, tight-drape coverage designed to collect modern radiometric data across priority areas spanning approximately 17 kilometres of prospective basin-margin strike, where Traction holds an option to earn an 80% interest from Cosa Resources. Data processing and geological interpretation are the next steps, with the company expecting to identify new drill targets for follow-up exploration on a property situated in one of Canada's most active emerging uranium exploration corridors.

headline: FIVE TARGETS IN ARROW'S SHADOW — BLAST OUTLINES URANIUM PROSPECTS IN ATHABASCA'S PATTERSON LAKE CORRIDOR (CSE:BLST)
snippet: Blast Resources Inc. (CSE:BLST) announced July 2 the results of completed exploration on three groups of claims in the southwestern Athabasca Basin, Saskatchewan, identifying five priority uranium targets through a high-resolution airborne magnetic survey over the Wales Lake Project — located 30 kilometres south of the Arrow and Triple R deposits and 10 kilometres south of F4 Uranium's discovery drill hole in the Patterson Lake Corridor. The Patterson Lake Corridor hosts the Arrow Deposit, the world's largest high-grade undeveloped uranium resource, projected to produce up to 30 million pounds of U₃O₈ per year at near-surface grades approaching 3%; proximity to established infrastructure and known high-grade mineralisation makes Wales Lake one of the Athabasca's most compelling early-stage uranium plays.

headline: RED LAKE MAIDEN DRILL COMPLETE — ATHENA GOLD WRAPS 5,134m IN NINE HOLES AT LAIRD LAKE, ASSAYS BY AUGUST (CSE:ATHA)
snippet: Athena Gold Corporation (CSE:ATHA) announced July 2 that its maiden diamond drill program at the Laird Lake Project in Ontario's Red Lake Gold District is complete — 5,134 metres across nine drill holes targeting the Balmer-Confederation Assemblage contact that underlies the entire Red Lake gold camp — with all core dispatched for assay and results expected by early August. The 7,000-hectare property covers more than 10 kilometres of the geological contact responsible for Red Lake's world-class gold endowment, and recent surface sampling returned values up to 373 g/t Au, making this one of the most watched first-drill-season tests in the camp this summer.

headline: CATL RESTART CHATTER TANKS LITHIUM TO 3-MONTH LOW — JIANXIAWO SPECULATION HITS CNY 151,750/T DESPITE 18-MONTH PERMIT HURDLE
snippet: Lithium carbonate prices in China fell to CNY 151,750 per tonne — a three-month low — after a government land assessment triggered market speculation that CATL's Jianxiawo mine in Jiangxi could restart, despite analysts warning that a new mining licence could take 12 to 18 months to obtain after the original land approval was cancelled. Jianxiawo was shut in August 2025 when its permit expired and accounts for roughly 3% of global lithium production; while the market priced in a near-term resumption, the structural demand from new EV battery capacity scheduled for Q3 2026 means analysts expect the medium-term lithium supply-demand balance to remain tight regardless of whether Jianxiawo restarts — and the price dip is being watched as a potential re-entry point by Western lithium developers whose projects offer China-independent supply.

headline: WHITE MESA BEGINS HEAVY REE CIRCUIT UPGRADES — ENERGY FUELS TARGETING COMMERCIAL Tb AND Dy PRODUCTION BY Q4 2026 (NYSE:UUUU)
source_name: Crux Investor / Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE:UUUU / TSX:EFR)
snippet: Energy Fuels Inc. (NYSE:UUUU / TSX:EFR) commenced modifications this month to its Phase 1 rare earth circuits at the White Mesa Mill in Utah, targeting commercial-scale separation of heavy rare earth oxides — samarium, europium, gadolinium, terbium, and dysprosium — alongside existing NdPr production, with the first commercial output expected Q4 2026. White Mesa is the only operating facility in the United States producing separated heavy rare earth oxides from mined ores, and the circuit upgrade puts Energy Fuels on a direct collision course with China's processing monopoly on dysprosium and terbium — the elements that enable the permanent magnets in EV motors and defence systems — in a period when Project Vault's US$10 billion strategic reserve mandate has made domestic heavy REE production a top national security priority.
